name: codex-task-control
description: A local Windows control centre for Codex tasks that finish but leave Send disabled, plus privacy-safe usage analysis and local-work controls.

interface.shortDescription: Recover follow-ups and analyze local Codex usage.
interface.longDescription: Install and operate the local Codex Command and Control centre on Windows. It can safely send a follow-up to an idle finished task, show privacy-safe token, timing, context, tool, activity and storage statistics, compare turns, and deliberately stop all local Codex work.
defaultPrompt: Install Codex Command and Control on this Windows computer.
Open Codex Command and Control for this task.
Help me recover a task whose Send button is stuck.
Analyze my recent Codex usage and suggest efficiency improvements.
